Lukas / team — quick triage notes (first 20m):
- Symptoms: sudden spike in queue length (kqps) on the us-west-2 pool serving ShopFlex. KV cache eviction rate also spiked at the same time.
- Timeline: ~08:50 we started seeing increased kernel scheduling latencies on a subset of hosts that received a rolling micro-kernel update last night (opt scheduling flags). Correlation is high but not yet definitive.
- Impact surface: ~3% of ShopFlex requests hit >5s stall, ~0.2% timed out (15s). No widespread 5xx elsewhere.

Immediate mitigation plan (executing now):
1) Revert the scheduling micro-optimization on the affected subset (rolling rollback in progress, ETA 14m).
2) Enable prefix/KV warm-up for ShopFlex for next 60m (manual boost).
3) Temporarily route ShopFlex traffic to a reserved warm pool (scaling + burst enabled).
4) If p99 doesn't improve within 20m after rollback, throttle heavy clients (ShopFlex consent required).

I attached a short sample of request latency spikes: latency-samples.txt (contains head and tail traces).

Permission to send ShopFlex a short "we have applied mitigations and are monitoring; expect update in 30m" message? I'll keep the team updated in this thread.

-Karthik
